product.title: 10,000 Islands Boat Tour + Naturalist Led Walk in the Everglades!

description.text: Visit two national parks in a half day! There is always the chance to spot manatees, critically endangered sawtooth fish and sharks. This is a birding hot spot and you may see roseate spoonbills and white pelicans. Ideal for Naples travelers who want a guided Everglades outing with transport, mangrove channels, and expert naturalist commentary included.
